unit.title: From Correct Algorithm to Reliable Service: A Dependency-Planner Vertical Slice
unit.scope: One manager-authored kickoff unit, not an official CS169 unit or a reconstruction of the full course.
unit.audience: A strong algorithms student beginning deliberate software-engineering practice.
learning_objectives: Translate a small user need into an explicit service contract and acceptance scenarios.
Wrap a familiar dependency-ordering algorithm in a deterministic HTTP boundary.
Use automated tests to cover normal, invalid, and failure behavior.
Make a small implementation reproducible and reviewable through documentation and captured evidence.
Distinguish evidence for one completed slice from evidence for course completion.

unit_completion_requires: A runnable implementation satisfying the specified service contract.
Automated tests with reproducible passing output for required behavior and edge cases.
Learner-authored engineering documentation and comprehension responses.
completion_policy.evidence_rule: Files, executable checks, and validator-observed results are evidence; a learner or agent prose claim is not.
completion_policy.promotion_authority: Only the worker-harness-controlled validator may promote this unit to completed.
completion_policy.effect_of_unit_pass: A pass completes only kickoff_dependency_planner_vertical_slice_v1 and leaves the course incomplete.
completion_policy.whole_course_policy: No whole-course completion condition is defined by this preparation job. Later jobs must retrieve, classify, sequence, and validate additional units before making any broader claim.

provenance.input_scope: The catalog snapshot embedded in the preparation job; no external content was retrieved.
